description: Reply frame checks, end codes and their mapping to a config or a comm error (D-053, D-056).

vectors.description: A good reply with the two words asked for.
One word.
One word fewer than asked is an error, not a zero.

expected.frame_error: reply carries 2 data bytes for 2 words

vectors.description: One word more than asked is an error.

expected.frame_error: reply carries 6 data bytes for 2 words

vectors.description: An odd number of data bytes.

expected.frame_error: reply carries 3 data bytes for 2 words

vectors.description: End code 0 and no data.

expected.frame_error: reply carries 0 data bytes for 1 words

vectors.description: A reply that does not start with d000.
A request frame (5000...) is not a reply.
The header announces more than the frame carries.

expected.frame_error: reply announces 9 bytes after the header, carries 4

vectors.description: The header announces less than the frame carries.

expected.frame_error: reply announces 3 bytes after the header, carries 4

vectors.description: A frame that ends inside the header.

expected.frame_error: reply of 8 bytes is shorter than a 3E reply header

vectors.description: An empty frame.

expected.frame_error: reply of 0 bytes is shorter than a 3E reply header

vectors.description: A header announcing no end code.

expected.frame_error: reply of 9 bytes is shorter than a 3E reply header
